sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 negative: test_mode refuses to actuate on an undeclared instance and stamps synthetic evidence
sys_atf_test.description: test_mode is honoured only on an instance listed in nonprod_instances; elsewhere the app refuses. Evidence produced under it is machine-detectable as synthetic.

sys_atf_step.description: With the instance removed from the allowlist, actuation must refuse rather than proceed in either direction.
Evidence produced under test_mode must be stamped synthetic so the attestation pipeline can reject it mechanically.
